name: Example: Righteous Fire Chieftain (Mirage-league meta tree)
notes: Modeled on a popular poe.ninja Mirage-league Righteous Fire Chieftain (level 100, 8.2k life), validated against this deployment’s tree (3.28.0k Mirage). The armour/regen archetype: RF burns you and everything near you; the tree stacks % maximum life (this tree carries ~122% increased life — tanky archetypes run 115-160%), life regen, endurance charges and Unwavering Stance. Resistances come from gear, not the tree.
